verdict.rationale: Ashby is a SaaS recruiting platform. Open-sourcing its code is a fair question for this kind of product, since open-source ATS products exist, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions a public source repository or an open license. The items cover hosted features, a proprietary API, webhooks and an MCP server, none of which amount to readable source under an open license.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
